name: @gristlabs/widget-actionbutton
description: A configurable button widget that supports multiple action columns with grouped buttons. Features a built-in configuration panel for styling, icons, and layout.

grist.name: Action button
grist.description: Build one or more buttons that send customizable actions (e.g. "AddRecord") to the Grist data engine. Supports multiple columns for grouped action buttons, with a configuration panel for styling, icons, and layout.
